fato_historico: 1962: Cuban Missile Crisis: Adlai Stevenson shows the United Nations Security Council reconnaissance photographs of Soviet ballistic missiles in Cuba.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to peer behind the curtain today, Scorpio. Just as hidden fragments of reality were once brought into the light to resolve a global tension, you may feel an urge to reveal long-held secrets. Consider this a time to face complex situations with clarity, as truth often serves as the most powerful key to long-term peace and personal growth.
frase_do_dia: Truth is the ultimate foundation upon which your inner strength is built today.
significado_numero: The number of introspection and deep emotional intelligence in your life.
conselho: Communicate your perspectives with steady confidence and gentle, unwavering honesty.
